subject: Is RHIPE compatible with Mac OS X 10.6?

messages.author: 2cf0d6dfd4f09aee
messages.subject: Is RHIPE compatible with Mac OS X 10.6?
parts:
It mentioned here:

https://github.com/saptarshiguha/RHIPE/blob/master/index.org

that RHIPE does not work on Mac OS X Snow Leopard. Any change since
the last post?

I did go ahead and install RHIPE on my os x 10.6.8. The installation
went through so I went on with some experiments. All is done in a
standalone mode.

The first one worked:

rhwrite(list(1,2,3),"/tmp/test")
rhread("/tmp/test")

I then tried the wordgen example from:

https://github.com/saptarshiguha/RHIPE/wiki/Wordgen

that's when the " Error in readBin(f1, "raw", f2) : invalid 'n'
argument" thrown in. I set local to be true for make.words() since I'm
running on a standalone mode. Actually I got same error if I left
local with default setting.

The version of R I am using is 2.14.2
protobuf: 2.4.1
Rhipe: 0.66

Full error output follows. If RHIPE is not supported on Snow Leopard,
will that change in the near future? If it does, any suggestion on how
to fix the problem is appreciated.

Thanks,

- Fionna

This is not a Snow Leopard issue. I'd have to look into it - haven't visited the wordgen example.
I'll get back to you soon.

But no, no plans on supporting Snow Leopard.

Saptarshi
